access.note: Tested on 2026-10-12 (13:02 UTC) from the build environment with curl through its proxy (one HTTPS request to the root address of each host). Hosts: knu.ua, biomed.knu.ua, pdis.knu.ua (official); registry.edbo.gov.ua, naqa.gov.ua, studyinukraine.gov.ua, mon.gov.ua (government and register). Every host was refused at the environment's proxy under its network policy (curl: "CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403"; HTTP code 000). No official page or PDF was opened and no claim was checked. Route to access: the environment's Network access setting (Allowed domains); see OWNER_ACTION_SHEET.md §1.
